title: linum gallicum subsp. strictum
intro: Linum gallicum subsp. strictum, commonly known as French flax or strict blue flax, is a plant species within the Linaceae family, characterized by its blue flowers and slender stems. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Linum gallicum subsp. strictum include soothing and calming effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
